svg.title: Forge Review concept, 160 columns by 50 rows
svg.desc: The answer explains the change; the adjacent inspector shows its evidence. Both share one full-width prompt. Line numbers, hunk labels, and +/− signs retain meaning in monochrome. Selected files and keyboard focus look different. At 80 columns, F6 switches chat and diff without losing the draft or selected file. No miniature unreadable split.
svg.text: Add bounded retries for transient provider errors.
Added bounded retries at the provider boundary. Transient failures back
off; terminal errors still return immediately.
No changes committed. Ready for your review.
Also cover exhausted retries with a regression test.
